description: An interactive data-visualization gallery released and operated by NWEA Research to let users explore relationships between school poverty, achievement, and growth in the report's sample.
title: Evaluating the Relationships Between Poverty and School Performance interactive data visualization gallery

description: A 35-item five-point Likert self-assessment developed by the research team to measure higher vocational nursing students’ gerontological nursing competence across practice, professional development, communication and cooperation, and legal-ethical quality.
title: Evaluation scale of gerontological nursing competence for higher vocational nursing students (35 items, four dimensions)

description: An open-ended, formative template proposed by Natalia Kucirkova and colleagues for evaluating and strengthening evidence about educational technology, intended to complement internal research and national standards.
title: EVER

description: Every Circuit is a web-based and mobile interactive circuit simulator developed by MuseMaze that lets learners construct circuits and observe electrical quantities and behavior.
title: Every Circuit

description: A Gates Foundation-funded Every Learner Everywhere initiative in which a network of organizations helps participating colleges implement adaptive courseware in gateway courses through technical assistance, communities of practice, subgrants, and research support.
title: Every Learner Everywhere Lighthouse Institution Program and Technical Assistance Model

description: A school- and district-partnered attendance intervention that analyzes attendance data and mails personalized absence reports to parents or guardians of students at risk of chronic absenteeism.
title: EveryDay Intervention

description: Everyday Mathematics® is a comprehensive pre-K–6 mathematics curriculum developed by the University of Chicago School Mathematics Project, combining teacher guides, student materials, manipulatives, games, technology, and repeated exposure to mathematical content.
title: Everyday Mathematics®

description: A web-based tool developed to teach undergraduate students across disciplines how to formulate evidence-based questions, search for information, and critically appraise online sources.
title: Evidence-based internet research tool (EBR tool)

description: A bespoke web-based service developed by Sandringham School, the Institute for Effective Education at the University of York, and the Coalition for Evidence Based Education that brokers teachers' and school leaders' questions to relevant research evidence and academics.
title: Evidence for the Frontline (E4F) online evidence brokerage service

description: A free online platform offered by the Regional Educational Laboratory Mid-Atlantic that helps schools and teachers use their own data to identify effective remote-learning strategies and refine practice.
title: Evidence to Insights (e2i) Coach
